caption: A bird hops across a lawn outside a clear window and is seen through the glass.

sa.check: A bird hops across a lawn outside a window.
It is seen through the glass.

pc.expect: The bird is fully visible through the pane and moves continuously behind it.
pc.fail: The glass hides the bird; or the bird flickers in and out of view behind clear glass; or it is distorted by a flat pane.

pc.expect: The glass does not make the bird vanish or appear inside the room.
pc.fail: The bird vanishes behind the glass; or it appears inside the room; or a second bird appears.

pc.expect: The bird stays outside the window.
pc.fail: It passes through the glass; or the glass passes through it; or it perches inside the pane.

pc.expect: The pane is flat and rigid.
pc.fail: It ripples; or bends; or goes opaque.
It splits; or turns into another animal; or merges with the frame.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The plumage, the lawn and the window frame stay the same.
pc.fail: The plumage changes; or the lawn rearranges; or the frame changes.

note: The bird is self-driven; only transparency and containment are judged.
